hypothesis.observation: The annual report lists 41 distribution centers folded in from three regional operators over six years.
hypothesis.problemHypothesis: Each region still runs its own version of the same shift, so one trailer event is counted three ways before it reaches the executive.

evidence.title: Annual report 2025: 41 distribution centers across three acquired regional networks
Careers: Regional Operations Analyst, reconciles DC scorecards across regions
Investor day 2026: one operating model initiative, integration owner in the COO office
Q2 earnings call: integration target for the acquired network, shared systems by year end

hypothesis.observation: The Fontana DC opened 30 more dock doors in the spring expansion while the lot still holds about 180 trailer spots.
hypothesis.problemHypothesis: The doors are no longer the constraint; the lot is, and reactive moves are where the added capacity goes to wait.

evidence.title: Fontana DC expansion: 30 new dock doors, lot unchanged at 180 trailer spots (trade press)
Careers: two second-shift spotter openings at Fontana, mandatory weekend overtime
Q2 earnings call: Fontana shipping near capacity, next wave of volume routed there
Investor deck: Fontana named highest-volume DC in the network for the coming peak

hypothesis.observation: The Columbus plant announced an autonomous yard truck pilot for the second half of the year.
hypothesis.problemHypothesis: The truck will be fine; the moves it is handed are not deterministic yet, so radio calls and clipboard notes still decide which trailer goes where.

evidence.title: Press release: autonomous yard truck pilot at the Columbus plant, second half of the year
Careers: Automation Engineer, Columbus, exception handling for lot robotics
